Forced named tool choice returns structured tool_calls with finish_reason=stop; auto/required use tool_calls

cache.preparation: Host launcher user needs writable parent directories. Only the new dedicated cache directories had ownership adjusted; parent shared-cache permissions were not changed.

debug_findings.failure: Image overlay omitted generated vllm_flash_attn CUDA extensions
debug_findings.correction: Include the generated subpackage from the compiled fork extension tree, not only top-level .so files.
Use retained compiled extensions from the pinned fork, not the older base installation.

debug_findings.cause: Inherited vLLM .dockerignore excluded top-level extension files.
debug_findings.correction: The local extension-image packaging used a Dockerfile-specific ignore file to include .so artifacts. Clean-clone rebuild remains unverified.

debug_findings.failure: Launcher could not create system cache directory as unprivileged user
debug_findings.correction: Pre-create writable dedicated NAS cache directories and mount them explicitly.

debug_findings.failure: CUDA illegal memory access during later graph-capture warmup; other ranks subsequently reported NCCL errors

evidence.initial_failure: Illegal CUDA memory access during graph-capture warmup; subsequent NCCL error
actions: Fresh shared NAS cache, first populated with synchronous CUDA diagnostic run
Two normal-mode starts and API verification succeeded with same NAS cache
evidence.root_cause: Not isolated: successful recovery does not establish cache incompatibility as the cause

debug_findings.scope: A timing change and new caches were introduced together. No proof that cache incompatibility caused the fault.

debug_findings.failure: Docker stop briefly reported a zombie container PID
debug_findings.correction: Launch with Docker --init for child-process reaping. No broad daemon restart or GPU reset was used.

debug_findings.failure: Original SGLang rollback container disappeared after stop
debug_findings.correction: Recreated a stopped container from saved inspect: same image, argv, env, GPU requests, mounts, IPC, shared memory, ulimits, capabilities and ports; AutoRemove intentionally disabled.

validation.scope: Configured 1M context verified here; a full 1M request was exercised earlier on VM106, not repeated in this VM100 deployment check.

image_build_caveat: Validated with retained local base and fork-extension images. Clean-clone build and FlashInfer 0.6.18 versus fork requirement 0.6.18.post1 are not validated. DeepGEMM patch is shipped, not applied by the overlay.
rollback: Stop the vLLM container before starting preserved SGLang; both require the same GPUs and port. Raw inspect and machine-specific restore scripts remain private on the serving host.
